visualReview.notes: Inspected54 final current frames:12 portable,12 shared-material/flat-map and30 Earth-rig/native-field/tier views. The full Triumph Palace complex retains32 mapped height parts:connected lower towers/wings,160m shoulders,185m shaft,200/220m crown and264m spire. The broad10m roof court stays open above its floor;the end court stays outside the building. Near levels have a physical lower colonnade,188 reconstructed columns,two projecting porticoes and native-fitting entry stairs. Pale cladding/pilasters contrast with warm infill,dark shared window grids and green-grey roofs. Master retains denser sills,layered cornices,capital profiles and schematic garden beds;far levels aggregate the lower storey and roof volumes. Final review corrected an embedded facade camera and exposed missing window rows at map-height boundaries. Pane positions now use a global facade grid and clipped matching UVs across height bands;the60–65m regression probe passes. Five existing256px graphs are shared,no private or embedded images. Four focused tests prove exact source reconstruction,representative heights of every wing,both court relationships,real near arcade openings and canopy undersides,native field/stair contact,and exact four-tier budgets/layout. The actual production viewer removes all32 real PMTiles building parts while retaining four nearby native buildings. Exact Q80367 footprint and asymmetric part heights sign the NNE/SSW frame;spire center isX31.75,Z−0.25. The unmodified129x129/3m native field oversamples one coarse global DEM tile. Base160m,original grades,window/column counts and sections remain photographic/map reconstructions rather than surveyed values. Roof beds are schematic;opaque patterned glazing does not reproduce interiors. Small shallow-trim shadow/LOD differences and unmeasured physical-device timing remain explicit limitations.

siteIntegrationReview.source: Standard viewer PMTiles and one ordinary global Terrarium tile;no bespoke survey/terrain source.
siteIntegrationReview.notes: Native field is unmodified. Foundation skirts embed below its perimeter and both reconstructed stair ends sample it. Base reference160m is approximate. Exact original foundations,curbs,accessible gradients and landscaping are unsurveyed. All32 mapped parts are replaced in the production viewer fixture;nearby native buildings remain.

runtimeLodReview.notes: Four authored browser tiers;at most six draws;five shared texture graphs plus palette beds;no embedded/private images;separate position/normal streams. Detailed source master remains separate. Physical-device timing unmeasured.
